# Offline IFA test inputs

These are small **synthetic** documents reconstructed from the source structure
reported in Claude Code's R-000. They were not fetched from the IFA website.
The compressed round numbers (1-4) deliberately exercise range enumeration,
overlapping playoff ranges, future rows, and promotion playoffs without a season-sized fixture.
The raw XML bytes include escaped HTML, non-breaking-space separators, and Hebrew names.

Before the first authorized network collection, compare these fixtures with genuine
saved source responses. Tests below do not establish live endpoint compatibility or
validate the real number of rounds in all 21 seasons; that remains a data QA check.

The league_YEAR.html variants encode the actual round ranges reported in R-000
(including 36/37 promotion-test rounds and the 2011/12 format). They are also
synthetic, not archived source pages.
